question: 列出所有品牌与品类组合中，2026年9月12日前上架且当前在售的商品数量、平均售价（保留2位小数）、平均成本价（保留2位小数）及价格加成率（= (平均售价 - 平均成本价) / 平均成本价，保留4位小数），按商品数量降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand和category分组，筛选is_active=1且launch_date <= '2026-09-12'的商品，统计每组product_id数量、AVG(list_price)、AVG(cost_price)及对应加成率，结果按count desc排序，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT brand, category, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS avg_price, ROUND(AVG(cost_price), 2) AS avg_cost, ROUND((AVG(list_price) - AVG(cost_price)) / NULLIF(AVG(cost_price), 0), 4) AS markup_rate FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND launch_date <= '2026-09-12' GROUP BY brand, category ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个品牌下各品类中，近30天（以2026-09-12为基准）产生过销售的有效订单所覆盖的商品SKU数（即order_items.product_id去重计数），要求仅包含至少被5个不同用户购买过的品牌-品类组合，结果按覆盖SKU数降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 联结orders、order_items、products，限定orders.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 30 DAY)且order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')，按brand+category分组，COUNT(DISTINCT order_items.product_id)，同时HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT orders.user_id) >= 5，结果按SKU数降序排列，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS sku_count FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.brand, p.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) >= 5 ORDER BY sku_count DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有在售（is_active=1）商品中，所属品牌与品类组合的订单覆盖率（定义为：该品牌-品类组合下有销售记录的订单数 / 全部有效订单总数，保留4位小数），仅展示覆盖率大于0.5%的品牌与品类，按覆盖率降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 联结orders、order_items、products，限定orders.order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')且products.is_active=1，按brand+category分组计算COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)，除以全部有效订单总数，过滤结果>0.005，保留4位小数，按该比率降序排列，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, p.category, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')), 4) AS coverage_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY p.brand, p.category HAVING coverage_rate > 0.005 ORDER BY coverage_rate DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请输出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品的最低售价、最高售价、价格带宽度（= 最高-最低），以及该组合内商品均价（保留2位小数），仅包含价格带宽度超过200元且商品数不少于8个的组合，按价格带宽度降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand+category分组，筛选is_active=1，计算MIN(list_price)、MAX(list_price)、MAX-MIN、ROUND(AVG(list_price),2)，HAVING (MAX-MIN) > 200 AND COUNT(*) >= 8，按价格带宽度降序排列，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT brand, category, MIN(list_price) AS min_price, MAX(list_price) AS max_price, MAX(list_price) - MIN(list_price) AS price_range_width, ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY brand, category HAVING price_range_width > 200 AND COUNT(*) >= 8 ORDER BY price_range_width DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，在2026年9月12日前已上架且当前在售的商品里，单价（list_price）处于[100, 500]区间的商品数量、该区间内商品的平均成本价（保留2位小数）及平均毛利率（= (平均售价 - 平均成本价) / 平均售价，保留4位小数），按商品数量降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand+category分组，筛选is_active=1且launch_date <= '2026-09-12'且list_price BETWEEN 100 AND 500，统计COUNT(*)、ROUND(AVG(cost_price),2)、ROUND((AVG(list_price)-AVG(cost_price))/NULLIF(AVG(list_price),0),4)，按数量降序排列，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT brand, category, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(cost_price), 2) AS avg_cost, ROUND((AVG(list_price) - AVG(cost_price)) / NULLIF(AVG(list_price), 0), 4) AS gross_margin FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND launch_date <= '2026-09-12' AND list_price BETWEEN 100 AND 500 GROUP BY brand, category ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品的销量集中度（定义为：销量TOP3商品的销量之和 / 该组合全部商品销量总和，保留4位小数），仅展示销量总和不低于1000件的组合，按集中度升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 联结products、order_items，按brand+category分组，先计算每组合总销量SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty，再用窗口函数对每个组合内product_id按SUM(oi.quantity) DESC排序取前3，求和后除以total_qty；HAVING total_qty >= 1000；结果按集中度ASC排序，限100行。
reference_sql: WITH brand_cat_totals AS (SELECT p.brand, p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY p.brand, p.category HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) >= 1000), ranked_skus AS (SELECT p.brand, p.category, oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sku_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.brand, p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) AS rn FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY p.brand, p.category, oi.product_id) SELECT bct.brand, bct.category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rs.rn <= 3 THEN rs.sku_qty ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / bct.total_qty, 4) AS concentration FROM brand_cat_totals bct JOIN ranked_skus rs ON bct.brand = rs.brand AND bct.category = rs.category GROUP BY bct.brand, bct.category, bct.total_qty ORDER BY concentration ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品的平均售价（保留2位小数）与平均销量（按order_items.quantity计算，保留2位小数）的乘积（即预估销售额权重），仅包含平均售价高于300元且平均销量大于5的组合，按该乘积降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 联结products、order_items，按brand+category分组，计算ROUND(AVG(p.list_price),2)、ROUND(AVG(oi.quantity),2)，相乘得权重；HAVING AVG(p.list_price) > 300 AND AVG(oi.quantity) > 5；按乘积降序排列，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, p.category, ROUND(AVG(p.list_price) * AVG(oi.quantity), 2) AS price_quantity_weight FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY p.brand, p.category HAVING AVG(p.list_price) > 300 AND AVG(oi.quantity) > 5 ORDER BY price_quantity_weight DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品的平均单位利润（= 平均售价 - 平均成本价，保留2位小数）及对应商品数量，仅包含平均单位利润在50至200元之间且商品数不少于15个的组合，按平均单位利润降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand+category分组，筛选is_active=1，计算ROUND(AVG(list_price) - AVG(cost_price), 2) AS unit_profit，COUNT(*)，HAVING unit_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 200 AND COUNT(*) >= 15，按unit_profit DESC排序，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT brand, category, ROUND(AVG(list_price) - AVG(cost_price), 2) AS unit_profit, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY brand, category HAVING unit_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 200 AND COUNT(*) >= 15 ORDER BY unit_profit DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品在近7天（以2026-09-12为基准）产生的销售数量、销售金额（保留2位小数）及平均客单价（= 销售金额 / 有效订单数，保留2位小数），仅展示销售金额超过5000元的组合，按销售金额降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 联结orders、order_items、products，限定order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 7 DAY)且order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')，按brand+category分组，SUM(oi.quantity)、ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount),2)、ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2)，HAVING SUM(oi.item_amount) > 5000，按销售金额DESC排序，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity, ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount), 2) AS amount, ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.brand, p.category HAVING SUM(oi.item_amount) > 5000 ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品的销售价格分布偏态（Skewness）估算值（使用三阶中心矩公式：N·Σ(x_i−x̄)³/((N−1)(N−2)·s³)，保留4位小数），仅包含商品数不少于20个的组合，按偏态绝对值升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand+category分组，筛选is_active=1且COUNT(*)>=20，使用MySQL窗口函数近似计算偏态（需先算均值、标准差，再聚合三阶中心矩），结果按ABS(skewness) ASC排序，限100行。
reference_sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT brand, category, list_price, AVG(list_price) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, category) AS mean_price, STDDEV_SAMP(list_price) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, category) AS std_price, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, category) AS n FROM products WHERE is_active = 1), moments AS (SELECT brand, category, n, SUM(POW(list_price - mean_price, 3)) AS m3, std_price FROM stats WHERE std_price > 0 GROUP BY brand, category, n, std_price HAVING n >= 20) SELECT brand, category, ROUND((n * m3) / ((n - 1) * (n - 2) * POW(std_price, 3)), 4) AS skewness FROM moments ORDER BY ABS(skewness) ASC LIMIT 100;
